note-toolbar.description: List toolbars or a toolbar's items

toolbar.description: Toolbar to list items for (name or ID)

note-toolbar-add-break.description: Add a line break to a toolbar

focus.description: Focus the editor after executing the command (default: false)

note-toolbar-add-dv.description: Add a Dataview item to a toolbar

eval.description: Dataview expression to evaluate (required: eval, query, or file/path)

query.description: Dataview query to execute (required: eval, query, or file/path)

file.description: Filename to execute (required: eval, query, or file/path)

path.description: Filename with path to execute (required: eval, query, or file/path)

args.description: Comma-separated 'name: value' format, with string values in quotes

note-toolbar-add-file.description: Add a file item to a toolbar

path.description: Path of file to link to (required: file or path)

note-toolbar-add-group.description: Add an item group to a toolbar

toolbar.description: Toolbar to add as a group

note-toolbar-add-js.description: Add a JavaScript item to a toolbar

code.description: JavaScript code to execute (required: code, file, or path)

file.description: Filename to execute (required: code, file, or path)

path.description: Filename with path to execute (required: code, file, or path)

args.description: Comma-separated 'name: value' format, with string values in quotes

note-toolbar-add-menu.description: Add an item menu to a toolbar

toolbar.description: Toolbar to add as a menu

note-toolbar-add-sep.description: Add a separator to a toolbar

note-toolbar-add-spread.description: Add a spreader to a toolbar

note-toolbar-add-tp.description: List commands that add a Templater item to a toolbar

note-toolbar-add-tp-command.description: Add a Templater item to a toolbar: Execute Templater command.

note-toolbar-add-tp-create.description: Add a Templater item to a toolbar: Creates new note from template.

path.description: Template filename with path to create note from (required: file, or path)

note-toolbar-add-tp-exec.description: Add a Templater item to a toolbar: Execute Templater file.

path.description: Template filename with path to execute (required: file, or path)

file.description: Template filename to insert (required: file, or path)

path.description: Template filename with path to insert (required: file, or path)

note-toolbar-add-uri.description: Add a URI item to a toolbar

note-toolbar-copy.description: Copy one or more items to a toolbar

item.description: Item ID, or comma-separated list of item IDs

note-toolbar-gallery.description: List items available in the Gallery

callout.description: Callout markdown (required: callout, file, or path)

path.description: Filename with path of callout (required: callout, file, or path)

note-toolbar-move.description: Move an item to a toolbar

icon.description: Toolbar icon, from Lucide's icon set

note-toolbar-settings.description: Open Note Toolbar settings in Obsidian

item.description: ID of item to open settings for

toolbar.description: Name or ID of toolbar to open settings for

note-toolbar-status.description: List toolbars that are visible (positioned) in the current view.

file.description: File to use the item in

path.description: Path of file to use the item in

icon.description: Item icon, from Lucide's icon set (required: label or icon)

pos.description: Item position in toolbar (default: end of toolbar)

to.description: Toolbar name or ID to add item to
